  • Method Details

    • getFaceValidationState

      FaceValidationState getFaceValidationState()
      gets the validation value of the face biometric. This can be checked against .Valid to see if there is a detected, valid face for this IFace instance. If, .DoesNotExist, then no face was detected.
      Returns:

    • createBitmap

      android.graphics.Bitmap createBitmap(boolean exportCroppedFace)
      creates a Bitmap object of the captured face. This face is the entire photo that was taken in the capture. The caller owns the created Bitmap
      Parameters:
      exportCroppedFace - whether to export just the cropped face, if detected. If no face is detected and this is true, no face is exported.
      Returns:
      a Bitmap object of the captured face. This face is the entire photo that was taken in the capture. The caller owns the created Bitmap

    • createBitmap

      android.graphics.Bitmap createBitmap(int maxDimension, boolean exportCroppedFace)
      creates a Bitmap object of the captured face. This face is the entire photo that was taken in the capture. The dimensions of the created image are uniformly scaled such that either dimension does not exceed . The caller owns the created Bitmap
      Parameters:
      maxDimension - the max width or height dimension of the created image. The dimensions of the created image are uniformly scaled such that either dimension does not exceed this
      exportCroppedFace - whether to export just the cropped face, if detected. If no face is detected and this is true, no face is exported.
      Returns:
      a Bitmap object of the captured face. Caller owns the created Bitmap
